title: 第4章  妖女，我要你助我修行
slug: 让你当炉做鼎你炼阴阳证大道
content_zh:
“滴上舌尖血后，便可发誓，你叫什么名字？”
“李寒山。”
“好，我来发誓，你先停下！”
大床上，花弄影咬破舌尖，将一滴血滴在了心魔誓约上，手指并拢，指天发誓：
“我花弄影以心魔为誓，自愿为李寒山之奴，此生此世，奉李寒山为主，为主之命是从，若有违逆，心魔噬体，魂飞魄散，永世不得超生！”
话音刚落，那心魔誓约便化为灰烬，变成一黑一白两个光点，黑的没入花弄影眉心，白的则进入李寒山眉心。
“还真是誓约。”
李寒山心中一定，福至心灵般知晓了誓约的存在。
花弄影眼巴巴地看着他：“现在你可以放开我了吧？”
李寒山垂眼扫过她那张强装恭顺的狐媚脸，没有立刻松手，而是先将自己被吸走的纯阳之气尽数吸回，接着运起阳册功法，开始从花弄影体内汲取灵力。
他要趁此机会，让自己突破炼气，这样面对花弄影，才不至于毫无反抗之力。
花弄影俏脸一变，她感受到了李寒山的举动。
她眼波流转，楚楚可怜，声音又娇又糯：“主人，奴家重伤未愈，您先让人家疗伤好不好？”
这一声“主人”喊得亲切又自然，仿佛她真心接受了为奴的命运一般。
李寒山摇头：“不好，等我突破炼气，我便放开你。”
花弄影见他态度坚决，也只好认命：“好吧，主人，那您快点，久了奴家会撑不住的。”
李寒山不再废话，阳册功法全力运转。
花弄影的灵力，被他源源不断的汲取，再通过阳册功法炼化之后，变成了他自身的力量。
这个过程，比起李寒山自己拿着灵石去修炼，不知道快了多少倍。
仅仅一个时辰不到，他的丹田里，第一滴灵力诞生了。

“炼气！”
李寒山精神一振。
他突破炼气了，修为来到了炼气一层！
“怪不得合欢宗如此强盛！”
他有所明悟。
合欢宗通过采补来修炼，成长的速度远超普通修士。
当然，能够有如此快的修炼速度，主要还是阳册功法的神奇。换成合欢宗的功法，也没有这等速度。
“他竟然突破了......”
身下的花弄影察觉到李寒山的突破后，俏脸之上满是讶色。
这突破的速度，远超她的想象。
花弄影声音中带着几分喜色：“恭喜主人突破炼气，主人，您现在可以放开我了吧？”
“等等。”
李寒山又从花弄影体内汲取了不少好处，让自己的修为进一步提升，直到他感觉到极度疲惫后，这才停了下来。
他这具身体太苍老了，经不起太长时间的折腾。
他将花弄影放开，心中却是极度警惕。
好在，花弄影并未发出攻击，而是简单的清理了一下自己的身体后，便默默起身，挑选了一瓶疗伤的丹药。
“主人，奴家去恢复一下。”
花弄影匆匆进了里间。
她倒没有说谎，这一次她遭受重创，需要不少时间来恢复了。
“呼！活下来了！”

花弄影走后，李寒山长出了一口气，只觉得全身都要虚脱了。
这一趟不仅活下来了，还成功开了脉，将修为提升到了炼气一层，甚至把花弄影这个千娇百媚的妖女变成了女奴，可谓是大获全胜。
他这地狱式的天崩开局，总算凭借那神奇的梦境，以及梦里的少女洛璃，成功翻了身，一把烂牌打成了王炸。
虽然，李寒山总觉得那心魔誓约没那么简单，花弄影说不定还有什么应对之法，但现在的局面于他来说已然是最佳。
“这血......”
李寒山突然注意到，床单上的血渍有些不一般，除了花弄影接连吐出的血外，还有几朵梅花格外惹眼。
这让李寒山不由想到一个荒谬的可能，可他想到花弄影的身份与先前看到的干尸，立马否定了这种可能：“她这样的妖女，身子不可能还清白......”
“先巩固巩固，把修为尽快提升上去。”
李寒山有了计划，在这吃人不吐骨头的合欢宗，必须有足够的实力，才能活下来。
至于逃走，李寒山想都没想，就算能逃出去，合欢宗周边那遍布妖兽的十万大山，就足以把他吞得连骨头都不剩。
既来之，则安之。
先在合欢宗站稳脚，把修为提升上去跟再说。
李寒山将床上的灵石丹药之类的尽数收起，又叫来两个婢女将房间打扫了一番，便开始巩固起来。
....
在李寒山修炼之时，里间，花弄影踏入了一个热气腾腾的池子里，将身上的污秽洗去。
“该死！”
花弄影刚刚的娇媚早已消失无踪，美眸之中满是怒火，这一次她的损失太大了，纯阳圣体没了，还变成了自己的主人，她自己更是身负重伤！
至于她的身子，在这些事情面前，倒算是小事。
身在合欢宗，这一天是迟早的事。
如果她的修为停滞不前，早晚有一天，门内那些如狼似虎师兄师叔们，会将她当成炉鼎，扑上来将她啃食殆尽。

是的，李寒山怎么也没想到，最不可能的可能发生了。
这表面上浪荡无比的妖女，居然还保留着清白的身子。
“这是什么？”
这时，花弄影突然在自己的小腹处发现了一道极淡的纹路。
她缓缓凑近了看。
那纹路很浅，浅到不仔细看几乎察觉不到，像是有人用极细的笔尖，在她小腹上轻轻勾勒了几笔。
形状有些古怪——像是一朵含苞待放的花，又像是什么古老繁复的符文，隐隐约约，若隐若现。
花弄影伸手摸了摸，指尖触到那片肌肤时，微微有些发烫。
“该死，这是哪来的？不会是他弄的吧？”
花弄影试了试，发现自己根本没办法除掉这纹路后，怒火冲天，恨不得立马就杀了李寒山。
但有心魔誓约在，花弄影还真不能杀，否则她自己也毁了。
花弄影眼底杀意充盈：“李寒山啊李寒山，你绝对想不到，那心魔誓约只对炼气有效，老娘突破筑基之日，便是你丧命之时！”
心魔誓约确实没假，但那份誓约，效力仅限于炼气期，她只要突破，誓约自解。
“可恶！可恶！”
只是，一想到她堂堂合欢宗天骄，竟被李寒山这个老头子欺负成这样，花弄影就气得浑身发抖，银牙咬碎，眼泪更是止不住地往下掉。
“他一定身怀惊天功法，所以才能够挡住我的采补，甚至能强行从我体内汲取灵元......这功法，恐怕比祖师留下的无上秘法更加惊人！”
思及此处，花弄影唇角慢慢勾起一抹弧度，眼底重新有了光。
合欢宗的采补功法天下无双，更别提她修炼的可是祖师传下的无上秘法，但李寒山一介凡人，不仅挡住了她的采补，竟还能反制她！
这一次配合李寒山修炼，进一步让花弄影体会到了那门功法的霸道！
不难想象，李寒山身怀的功法有多么逆天！

她若是得到它，将来金丹，元婴，甚至化神都不是问题。
这才是她在立下心魔誓约后，对李寒山假意奉承的真正原因。
“主人，我会好好伺候你的，直到......老娘筑基的那一天......”
“呼，巩固得差不多了。”
外面，几天后，李寒山感觉自己的修为已经巩固。
他又尝试了一番修炼，发现自己修炼速度简直太慢了，于是李寒山起身，前往里间。
里间很大，一半房间一半山洞，石壁之下还有一方温泉。
花弄影正盘腿坐在床上修炼，看到李寒山进来，她心头恨意翻涌，面上却丝毫不显，反而嫣然一笑，软软唤道：“主人，你怎么来了？”
李寒山淡淡道：“妖女，我要你助我修行。”
“啊？”花弄影一愣。
随即，她那娇艳的红唇被李寒山含住。
content_en:
"After you drop blood on the tip of your tongue, you can swear, what is your name?"
"Li Hanshan."
"Okay, I swear, you stop first!"
On the big bed, Hua Nongying bit the tip of her tongue and dropped a drop of blood on the Heart Demon Oath. She put her fingers together and swore to the sky:
"I, Hua Nongying, swear by the inner demons and voluntarily become Li Hanshan's slave. In this life, I will serve Li Hanshan as my master and follow his orders. If I disobey, the inner demons will devour my body and my soul will fly away. I will never be reincarnated!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the inner demon oath turned into ashes and turned into two light spots, one black and one white. The black one disappeared into the center of Hua Nongying's eyebrows, while the white one entered the center of Li Hanshan's eyebrows.
"It's really a promise."
Li Hanshan was certain in his heart, and he was so blessed that he knew the existence of the oath in his heart.
Hua Nongying looked at him eagerly: "Can you let me go now?"
Li Hanshan lowered his eyes and glanced at her charming face that was pretending to be submissive. He did not let go immediately. Instead, he first sucked back all the pure Yang energy that had been sucked away from him, then used the Yang book technique and began to draw spiritual power from Hua Nongying's body.
He wanted to take this opportunity to break through in refining his Qi, so that he would not be helpless when facing Hua Nongying.
Hua Nongying's pretty face changed, she felt Li Hanshan's actions.
Her eyes were filled with emotion and she was pitiful, and her voice was soft and sweet: "Master, I'm seriously injured and haven't recovered yet. Can you let me heal first?"
This "Master" call was cordial and natural, as if she truly accepted the fate of being a slave.
Li Hanshan shook his head: "No, I will let you go when I break through the Qi refining process."
Seeing his resolute attitude, Hua Nongying had no choice but to accept her fate: "Okay, master, hurry up, the slave family will not be able to hold on for a long time."
Li Hanshan stopped talking nonsense, and the Yang Ce Kung Fu was running at full speed.
Hua Nongying's spiritual power was continuously absorbed by him, and after being refined through Yang Ce Kung Fu, it became his own power.
This process is many times faster than Li Hanshan practicing with the spirit stone himself.
In less than an hour, the first drop of spiritual power was born in his Dantian.
"Refining Qi!"
Li Hanshan perked up.
He has achieved a breakthrough in Qi refining and has reached the first level of Qi refining!
"No wonder the Hehuan Sect is so powerful!"
He had some realization.
The Hehuan Sect cultivates through the use of supplements and grows much faster than ordinary monks.
Of course, the main reason for such a fast cultivation speed is the magic of Yang Ce Cultivation Technique. Even if it were the Hehuan Sect's technique, it wouldn't be as fast.
"He actually broke through..."
After Hua Nongying noticed Li Hanshan's breakthrough, her pretty face was filled with surprise.
The speed of this breakthrough was far beyond her imagination.
There was a hint of joy in Hua Nongying's voice: "Congratulations, Master, for your breakthrough in refining Qi. Master, can you let me go now?"
"Wait."
Li Hanshan drew a lot of benefits from Hua Nongying's body and further improved his cultivation. He didn't stop until he felt extremely tired.
His body is too old and cannot withstand the abuse for too long.
He let go of Hua Nongying, but he was extremely vigilant in his heart.
Fortunately, Hua Nongying did not attack. Instead, she simply cleaned her body, stood up silently, and selected a bottle of healing elixir.
"Master, please go and recover."
Hua Nongying hurried into the inner room.
She wasn't lying. This time she was hit hard and needed a lot of time to recover.
"Phew! Survived!"
After Hua Nongying left, Li Hanshan let out a sigh of relief and felt that his whole body was about to collapse.
Not only did he survive this trip, but he also successfully opened his pulse, raised his cultivation to the level of Qi refining, and even turned Hua Nongying, a charming witch, into a slave girl. It was a great victory.
After his hellish start, he finally managed to turn over with the help of his magical dream and the girl Luo Li in the dream, and he became a king with a bad hand.
Although, Li Hanshan always felt that the inner demon vowedMaking a date is not that simple. Hua Nongying may have other ways to deal with it, but the current situation is already the best for him.
"This blood..."
Li Hanshan suddenly noticed that there was something unusual about the blood stains on the sheets. In addition to the blood that Hua Nongying spat out one after another, there were also a few plum blossoms that stood out.
This made Li Hanshan think of a ridiculous possibility, but when he thought of Hua Nongying's identity and the mummy he had seen before, he immediately rejected this possibility: "It is impossible for a witch like her to remain innocent..."
"Consolidate it first and improve your cultivation as soon as possible."
Li Hanshan had a plan. In this Hehuan Sect that eats people without spitting out bones, they must have enough strength to survive.
As for escaping, Li Hanshan didn't even think about it. Even if he could escape, the hundred thousand mountains full of monsters around Hehuan Sect would be enough to swallow him without leaving any bones.
Once it comes, make peace with it.
First establish a foothold in the Hehuan Sect and improve your cultivation level.
Li Hanshan put away all the spiritual stones and elixirs on the bed, called two maids to clean the room, and then began to consolidate it.
....
While Li Hanshan was practicing, Hua Nongying stepped into a steaming pool to wash away the dirt on her body.
"Damn it!"
Hua Nongying's charm just now has long since disappeared, and her beautiful eyes are full of anger. This time, her loss is too great. The Pure Yang Holy Body is gone, she has become her own master, and she herself is seriously injured!
As for her body, it is a trivial matter in the face of these things.
In the Hehuan Sect, this day was a matter of time.
If her cultivation stagnates, sooner or later, those wolf-like and tiger-like brothers and uncles in the sect will treat her like a furnace and pounce on her to eat her up.
Yes, Li Hanshan never expected that the most impossible possibility would happen.
This seemingly slutty witch actually still retains her innocence.
"What is this?"
At this time, Hua Nongying suddenly discovered a very faint line on her lower abdomen.
She slowly looked closer.
The lines were very shallow, so shallow that they were almost undetectable unless you looked carefully. It was as if someone had used a very fine pen tip to lightly outline a few strokes on her lower abdomen.
The shape is a bit strange - like a budding flower, or some ancient and complicated runes, vague and looming.
Hua Nongying reached out and touched it. When her fingertips touched the skin, it felt slightly hot.
"Damn it, where did this come from? He couldn't have done it, right?"
Hua Nongying tried it and found that she couldn't get rid of the lines. She was so angry that she wanted to kill Li Hanshan immediately.
But with the inner demon's oath, Hua Nongying really can't be killed, otherwise she herself will be destroyed.
Hua Nongying's eyes were full of murderous intent: "Li Hanshan, Li Hanshan, you would never have imagined that the Heart Demon Oath is only effective for refining Qi. The day I break through the foundation building, that's when you will die!"
The inner demon's oath was indeed true, but that oath was only valid during the Qi refining period. As long as she broke through, the oath would be released.
"Damn it! Damn it!"
However, when she thought that she, the proud genius of the Hehuan Sect, was bullied like this by an old man like Li Hanshan, Hua Nongying was so angry that her whole body trembled, her silver teeth were broken, and her tears couldn't stop falling.
"He must possess a shocking skill, so he can block my harvesting, and even forcefully extract spiritual energy from my body... This skill is probably even more amazing than the supreme secret method left by the ancestor!"
Thinking of this, the corners of Hua Nongying's lips slowly curved, and her eyes regained light.
The Hehuan Sect's tonic gathering skills are unparalleled in the world, not to mention that she practices the supreme secret method passed down by the ancestor. However, Li Hanshan, a mortal, not only blocked her tonic gathering, but he was also able to counterattack her!
This time, practicing with Li Hanshan, Hua Nongying further realized the dominance of that technique!
It is not difficult to imagine that Li Hanshan is carryingHow incredible the technique is!
If she gets it, golden elixir, Nascent Soul, and even god transformation will not be a problem in the future.
This was the real reason why she pretended to flatter Li Hanshan after making the vow to the inner demon.
"Master, I will serve you well until...the day when I build the foundation..."
"Phew, it's almost consolidated."
Outside, a few days later, Li Hanshan felt that his cultivation had been consolidated.
He tried some practice again and found that his practice speed was simply too slow, so Li Hanshan got up and went to the inner room.
The inner room is very large, half room and half cave, and there is a hot spring under the stone wall.
Hua Nongying was sitting cross-legged on the bed practicing. When she saw Li Hanshan come in, hatred surged in her heart, but it didn't show on her face at all. Instead, she smiled sweetly and called softly: "Master, why are you here?"
Li Hanshan said calmly: "Demon girl, I want you to help me practice."
"Ah?" Hua Nongying was stunned.
Immediately, her beautiful red lips were captured by Li Hanshan.
